damascus-gate.place: Damascus Gate (Bab al-Amud), Old City of Jerusalem
damascus-gate.description: The Damascus Gate is a key entrance to the Old City of Jerusalem, located on the northwest side and historically connecting the city to Nablus and Damascus. Its Arabic name, Bāb al-ʿĀmūd, refers to a Roman column that once stood behind the gate, while its modern English and Hebrew names reference its connection to Damascus and Shechem (Nablus).
